title: Global and nonglobal solutions for an abstract semilinear heat equation
summary: In this paper, we focus on the existence of both global and non-global nonnegative solutions for the abstract semilinear heat equation $u_t - Lu = \sum_{i=1}^k \ell_i(t) f_i(u)$ in $L^p(X, μ)$. Here $(X,μ)$ represents a $σ$-finite measure space, $L$ is the infinitesimal generator of a sub-Markovian strongly continuous semigroup of bounded linear operators in $L^p(X,μ)$, and for each $i = 1, \ldots, k$, the functions $\ell_i: [0, \infty) \rightarrow [0, \infty)$ and $f_i: [0, \infty) \rightarrow [0, \infty)$ are continuous.
